verdict.rationale: The core Semgrep CLI/engine is hosted publicly on GitHub (github.com/semgrep/semgrep), and multiple evidence items quote directly from that repo, showing its source is readable; community commentary also frames it as an open alternative to closed tools like CodeQL (semgrep-comm-5). However, the evidence pack never states an explicit open-source license, and the broader AppSec Platform (Code, Secrets, Supply Chain) is proprietary SaaS, not source-available. Missing for 10: explicit license text/citation (e.g., LGPL) confirming terms, and clarification of which components are open vs. closed.
